answers.core: It is a feature already existent in the Editor Settings; adding a resizing bar simply improves the user experience by reducing the number of clicks to access it. It also allows users to change their FileSystem thumbnails on the fly in a way that could be considered universally better for all Godot users - it does not limit space if it doesn't get used, and provides new functionality if it does.
answers.workaround: Realistically whenever thumbnail view is used in the FileSystem, the resizer will also be used. Since it is a baseline UX change, it cannot be worked around in any given project. However, because it doesn't take up any additional screen real-estate, it will never need to be.

title: Add a slider to change the thumbnail size in the FileSystem dock
